data.title: Musk Loses Bid To Block MN Law Against AI Child Porn - Joe.My.God.
data.description: Politico reports: A federal judge Friday refused to block a Minnesota law prohibiting the creation of sexually explicit deepfake images that’s being challenged by Elon Musk’s artificial intelligence company, SpaceXAI. U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank said the company, formerly known as xAI, waited too long in making its last-minute request to temporarily block the law …
data.author: Joe Jervis
